description:
Use this when OpenApps' tools or data fail the user: an error, data the user says is wrong (such as an app bound to the wrong listing), a missing capability, or something confusing. Ask the user before sending a report they did not ask for. It is stored privately with the caller's account and client; no reply comes in this conversation. Summarize; never include secrets or personal data.
Do not use for other servers or the client app; it does not finish the user's task.

initiator.description: user if the user asked for it, else model.

name: feedback_send
title: Send feedback to OpenApps
